hypothesis: The remaining P_bg error after retarded-time alignment is primarily amplitude-conditioned: a per-record oracle scalar applied to the analytic Ricker-retarded template will reduce median calibration relative L2 below 0.2, even if one global train-fitted scalar does not.
expected_mechanism: Accurate travel time and source waveform should fix phase; per-record scalar fitting removes only amplitude. A low oracle error therefore justifies learning amplitude, while a high floor rejects the single-arrival template itself.
primary_metric: median train-only calibration relative L2 after per-record oracle scaling
failure_signal: Non-finite projection, missing records, or oracle median above 0.5 rejects a scalar-amplitude analytic propagator; no confirmation or project validation/test_id may be opened.
rollback: Preserve r42 and all prior artifacts; use the diagnostic only to choose between learned amplitude and a multi-arrival propagator representation.
